newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's says Croatia's ceillings "well positioned".
newsitem.headline: Moody's says Croatia's ceillings "well positioned".

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday Croatia's relatively low level of external debt, the success of its economic stabilisation plan and the diversity of its economy ensured the sovereign ceilings of BAA3 for its foreign-currency bonds and notes were "well positioned".

The rating agency said in a statement Croatia's debt ratios would grow slowly -- although staying at modest levels -- in view of the investment and infrastructural needs of the country and of sizeable current account deficits running at four to six percent of GDP.
It said as long as political stability in the region was maintained, medium-term growth prospects for the Croatian economy were strong.

But Moody's said Croatia's economy would need substantial amounts of external financing to rebuild the war-torn infrastructure and to revive the long-dormant ecnomic base and warned growth prospects would be hampered if political tensions in the region were heigtened.
